scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/client', {recursive: true}); fs.copyFileSync('src/client/index.html', 'dist/client/index.html'); fs.copyFileSync('src/client/styles.css', 'dist/client/styles.css'); fs.rmSync('dist/goat/vendor', {recursive: true, force: true}); fs.mkdirSync('dist/goat', {recursive: true}); fs.cpSync('src/goat/vendor', 'dist/goat/vendor', {recursive: true});"
